# Virginia Surveillance Force (VSF)

> Virginia Surveillance Force (VSF) provides professional armed and unarmed security, vehicle patrol, concierge, and protective guard services across Virginia, Maryland, and Washington, D.C. Established in 1987.

## Overview & Quick Facts
- Founded: 1987 (35+ years of operation)
- Headquarters: 7544 Diplomat Dr #101, Manassas, VA 20109
- Main Contact Phone: (703) 631-6559 | Toll-Free: (800) 786-0395
- Email: info@vsfus.com
- Web: https://www.vsfus.com/
- Active Personnel: 700+ Certified & Trained Officers
- Total Assignments Completed: 2,500+
- Service Radius: Commonwealth of Virginia, State of Maryland, District of Columbia (24/7/365 operational availability)

## Licensing & Registrations
- Virginia Department of Criminal Justice Services (DCJS): PSS # 11-2371
- District of Columbia Metropolitan Police Department (SOMB): # SAB200504
- Maryland State Police: License # 106-3249

- Manassas, VA (HQ): 7544 Diplomat Dr #101, Manassas, VA 20109 | (703) 631-6559

## Core Services
- Armed & Unarmed Security Officers: Trained officers for physical asset protection, access management, deterrence, and incident response.
- Special Police Officers (SPO): Commissioned security officers providing high-level law enforcement presence and site safety.
- Corporate & Office Security: Uniformed concierge officers, lobby access management, security desk personnel, and plainclothes protection.
- Vehicle Patrol Services: Marked mobile patrol units providing visible deterrence, alarm response, and scheduled lock/unlock services.
- Fire Watch Services: Specialized officers designated for continuous monitoring during fire suppression system maintenance, outages, or construction work.
- Executive Protection & Bodyguards: Protective detail for high-net-worth individuals, executives, and visiting dignitaries.
- Investigative & Courier Services: Armed/unarmed legal, medical, and high-value asset transport, plus background checking and investigative support.

## Industries & Sectors Served
- Government & Diplomatic Facilities: Sensitive federal, state, and diplomatic property security.
- Healthcare & Medical Centers: Hospitals, outpatient centers, and clinical facilities protecting staff, patients, and assets.
- Corporate Real Estate & Multi-Tenant Offices: Office towers, business parks, and corporate campuses.
- Residential, HOA & Gated Communities: Apartment complexes, condominiums, homeowner associations, and private estates.
- Retail & Commercial Property: Shopping malls, retail strip centers, and commercial hubs.
- Warehouses & Supply Chain Logistics: Industrial parks, distribution hubs, freight facilities, and storage sites.
- Hospitality: Hotels, resorts, and event venues.
- Educational Institutions: Private primary, secondary, and higher education campuses.
